scope_statement: Load management and injury awareness for youth coaches.
source_note: No sources were retrieved. The generation environment had no access to any external site, including the bodies this page points readers to. The Tier 1 source minimum is NOT met and this draft would not pass Tier 1 in the deployed pipeline.
claims_needing_verification: Load across every team an athlete plays for is the variable a coach most influences.
Raise volume, intensity or frequency one at a time, and protect rest weeks.
After an incident: stop the athlete, do not test the joint, tell a parent the same day.
Giving way, locking, early swelling, repeating pain and lost ability all need assessment.
Return to play is a clinical decision, not a coaching one.
